en.topic_title: Did Chinese cars squeal on Norway’s military?
en.topic_summary:
By Pierre-Henry Deshayes



Chinese-made cars filmed sensitive information during a Norwegian military exercise, including access codes at secure sites and officials’ comings and goings, raising concerns about the risks posed by connected vehicles.
